title: fix(ui): kanban owner, history timeline, user menu and presence stack draw letters-only initials
body:
Fixes #36346

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:看板卡片负责人、修改历史、右上角用户菜单和在线协作头像这四处,名字带括号或标点(如 Alice (Sales))的人,头像缩写从「A(」变成「AS」,单个英文名显示前两个字母。
- 为什么做:人员头像缩写统一一条规则的收尾,上一轮只修了人员单元格和头像字段,这次补齐其余四处。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是某处头像缩写字母不对,只影响显示、不碰数据,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

- **One rule, one home.** `getPersonInitials` (letters only, since the people-cell fix) moves from `@object-ui/fields` `widgets/personDisplay.ts` to a new `@object-ui/types` module `person-initials.ts`, exported from the types barrel. `@object-ui/fields` re-exports the same function from `personDisplay.ts`, so its own `getPersonInitials` export, its callers and its rule tests are unchanged.
- **Why `@object-ui/types` and not `@object-ui/fields`** (measured from each package.json): `@object-ui/auth` declares no `@object-ui` dependency at all (only `@objectstack/spec` and `better-auth`), while `@object-ui/fields` pulls in components, core, react, react-runtime, mobile, permissions and the markdown stack. Making the auth client depend on the field-renderer tier for one string helper inverts the tier order. `@object-ui/types` has no `@object-ui` dependency of its own, `@object-ui/collaboration` and `@object-ui/fields` already depend on it, and it is the same home, for the same reason, as the transient-HTTP-retry and in-flight-GET helpers already there. No cycle: nothing in the types closure depends on auth or collaboration.
- **The four faces:**
  - kanban card owner: `ownerInitials` in `KanbanCardOwner.ts` is now a re-export of `getPersonInitials` from `@object-ui/fields` (the package already depends on it). The board file `KanbanImpl.tsx` is deliberately left untouched so this PR does not conflict textually with the open kanban PR that edits the same import block.
  - history timeline: `HistoryTimeline.tsx` drops its private `initialsFromName` and calls `getPersonInitials` from `@object-ui/fields` (a declared peer, already used by `CommentAuthorAvatar`).
  - user menu: `getUserInitials` in `@object-ui/auth` keeps its signature and its email fallback, and reads the name through `getPersonInitials` from `@object-ui/types`; `@object-ui/auth` gains the `@object-ui/types` dependency (lockfile updated). It is the function `UserMenu`, app-shell's `AccountMenu` and the Console profile page draw with.
  - presence stack: `PresenceAvatars.tsx` drops its private `getInitials` and calls `getPersonInitials` from `@object-ui/types`.
- Behaviour change on the user menu that follows from "the same rule": a single-word name gives two letters (`Admin` gives `AD`, was `A`) and a three-word name gives first and last (`John Michael Doe` gives `JD`, was `JM`). The two auth unit tests that pinned the old outputs are updated.
- Clause-② measured on the built declarations: after `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build`, `ui/packages/types/dist/index.d.ts` carries `export { getPersonInitials } from './person-initials.js';` and `dist/person-initials.d.ts` declares `getPersonInitials(name: string): string`; `git grep getPersonInitials origin/main -- ui/packages/types/src` answers exit 1 (control: `git grep sharedGetJson origin/main -- ui/packages/types/src/index.ts` exit 0). A new export, nothing removed: `yes (widening)`. `ownerInitials` was never reachable from the `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` entry (`index.tsx` does not export `KanbanCardOwner`), so its change from function to re-export narrows nothing.

## Tests

- New family pin, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/personInitialsFamily-36346.test.tsx`: one `Alice (Sales)` name, four faces, each must draw `AS` — the real `ObjectKanban` owner avatar (with `ownerField`), the real `HistoryTimeline`, `getUserInitials`, and the real `PresenceAvatars`. It lives in `app-shell` because that is the one package depending on all four, so no new dependency edge.
- Ablation: one mutation of the shared rule, committed fix first, written through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit x1 -> x0, marker x0 -> x1, blob `0eb3e2f40c06` -> `72b58dc1b626`): the rule's first line replaced by the old naive split (`name.split(' ').map((p) => p[0])...`). The family pin went **4 failed of 4** — kanban owner, history timeline and presence stack each drew `A(` where `AS` was expected, `getUserInitials` answered `'A('`. Restored by the tool: blob after restore `0eb3e2f40c06` == HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty, marker count 0. No `dist/` in the path: every `@object-ui/*` specifier in these tests resolves to `src` through `ui/vitest.config.mts`'s alias map.

<details><summary>Test runs</summary>

All runs through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, on head `998bb5fdd1` (after `origin/main` merged):

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=verbose packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/personInitialsFamily-36346.test.tsx packages/plugin-kanban/ packages/auth/ packages/collaboration/ packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/HistoryTimeline.test.tsx packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/HistoryTimeline.actionLabel-28894.test.tsx packages/fields/src/widgets/personDisplay.test.ts` — `Test Files 140 passed (140)`, `Tests 1148 passed (1148)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`; the four family-pin cases each listed passed.
- Earlier, on `96825e61` (before the main merge): `packages/auth/ packages/collaboration/ packages/plugin-detail/ packages/fields/src/widgets packages/types/src/__tests__` plus the pin — `Test Files 1005 passed | 1 skipped (1006)`, `Tests 16417 passed | 18 skipped`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/` — `Test Files 172 passed | 2 skipped (174)`, exit 0.
- type-check, after `pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter='@object-ui/plugin-kanban^...'` (53 tasks successful): `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=1 --filter` types, fields, auth, collaboration, plugin-detail, plugin-kanban `run type-check` — each package's `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` echoed, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx` and `ui/packages/plugin-detail/README.md` name `getPersonInitials` of `@object-ui/fields`; that stays true (re-export), so no docs edit.
- `app-shell` type-check is declared to CI (`Type Check UI`): its dependency closure is most of `ui/`; the six packages whose source changed were type-checked locally.
